lines.text: Many learners say: He said me he is late.
Better: He told me he is late.
Told! She told me her name.

data.wrong: He said me he is late.
data.right: He told me he is late.

native.tip: Kita bilang “dia bilang ke saya”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai told me, bukan said me.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “He said me he is late.” 😅 Kalau ada me sesudahnya, pakai told: “He told me he is late.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “told”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “He told me.” Lalu buat kalimat dengan told me tentang temanmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “dia bilang ke saya”, but English uses told me, not said me.
en.caption: Ever say this? “He said me he is late.” 😅 When me comes next, use told: “He told me he is late.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
